description: A React component for managing permission schemes in Mattermost's admin console, including roles, teams, and permissions configuration.

classes.name: PermissionTeamSchemeSettings
classes.description: React component class for managing permission schemes in the admin console.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads roles, scheme, and scheme teams on component mount; handles URL query selection.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if all necessary data (roles, scheme, teams) are loaded.

methods.name: goToSelectedRow
methods.description: Scrolls to the selected permission row in the UI.

methods.name: selectRow
methods.description: Selects a permission row and scrolls to it.

methods.name: getStateRoles
methods.description: Returns roles based on current state or props, including derived roles.

methods.name: deriveRolesFromGuests
methods.description: Derives guest roles permissions from a base role.

methods.name: restoreGuestPermissions
methods.description: Restores permissions to guest roles, excluding certain included permissions.

methods.name: deriveRolesFromAllUsers
methods.description: Derives roles for all users from a base role.

methods.name: handleNameChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the scheme name input.

methods.name: handleDescriptionChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the scheme description input.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Saves the permission scheme, updates roles, and navigates back to permissions list.

methods.name: toggleRole
methods.description: Toggles the open/closed state of role sections.

methods.name: togglePermission
methods.description: Toggles permissions for a given role.

methods.name: openAddTeam
methods.description: Opens the modal to add teams.

methods.name: removeTeam
methods.description: Removes a team from the selected list.

methods.name: addTeams
methods.description: Adds selected teams to the list.

methods.name: haveGuestAccountsPermissions
methods.description: Checks if guest account permissions are enabled in the license.
